input.query: api refuses to start when a registered tool has no declared authority

content.text:
<context query="api refuses to start when a registered tool has no declared authority" template="default" budget="8000">
<section name="Relevant Code" source="code" priority="2">
<document source="apps/api/src/oversight/assertAllToolsDeclared.ts" type="code" relevance="1.00" tokens="113">
export function assertAllToolsDeclared(registry: ToolRegistry, table: AuthorityTable): void {
  const undeclared = registry
    .getDefinitions()
    .map((definition) => definition.name)
    .filter((name) => !Object.hasOwn(table, name));
  if (undeclared.length === 0) return;
  throw new Error(
    `The tool authority table has no row for ${undeclared.join(', ')}. Declare each registered tool in apps/api/src/oversight/toolAuthority.ts.`
  );
}
</document>
<document source="apps/api/src/oversight/toolAuthority.ts" type="code" relevance="0.51" tokens="40">
export function authorityOf(table: AuthorityTable, name: string): ToolAuthority {
  return Object.hasOwn(table, name) ? table[name] : 'requires_human_action';
}
</document>
</section>

It collects the names from `registry.getDefinitions()` and keeps the ones missing from the authority table (checked with `Object.hasOwn`). If any are missing, it throws an Error: \"The tool authority table has no row for <names>. Declare each registered tool in apps/api/src/oversight/toolAuthority.ts.\" That error is what stops the API from starting. The retrieved context did not show where the API's startup code calls this function, so I can't name the call site. By contrast, `authorityOf` in toolAuthority.ts does not throw at runtime.
